items.headline: New skins
items.text: Try Field Atlas day and night, Phosphor, wallpaper colours, or the editor to make your own.

items.headline: Stats pages
items.text: Swipe the top panel for Clock, battery, network, apps, sound, media, calendar, timers, messages and Notes.

items.headline: Messages page
items.text: Read and reply to chats right from your home screen.

items.headline: Focus modes
items.text: Hide distracting apps with Work or Sleep, with an emergency pass when you need them.

items.headline: Lock a folder
items.text: Hide private apps behind your fingerprint or PIN.

items.headline: Your own wallpaper
items.text: Pick any picture for the background.

items.headline: Springy motion
items.text: Menus, sheets and the stats card now open and settle with a soft spring.

items.headline: Hub on its own card
items.text: The stats hub sits on its own card, with tabs for Clock, Power, Focus and Notes.

items.headline: Arc settings
items.text: Choose how far the arcs spin, how much they bounce, how much they magnify, and which show.

items.headline: New skins
items.text: Moss, Glass and Graphite join the gallery.

items.headline: Dot-matrix numbers
items.text: Moss, Glass and Graphite draw the clock and battery numbers in dots.

items.headline: Figtree text
items.text: All words in Parc now use the Figtree font.

items.headline: Settings in seven pages
items.text: Seven clear pages, and search finds every setting.

items.headline: Same glass on both hubs
items.text: Glass now looks the same on the arc hub and the stats hub, in every skin.

items.headline: Dim works on your picture
items.text: Dim darkens a picture you chose, and the glass cards darken with it.

items.headline: Build stamp
items.text: Backup and about shows the version and build time.
